targetTexts.1: Every wise woman builds her house, but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
targetTexts.2: He who walks in uprightness fears the LORD, but the one who is devious in his ways despises Him.
targetTexts.3: The proud speech of a fool brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
targetTexts.4: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but an abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox.
targetTexts.5: An honest witness does not deceive, but a dishonest witness pours forth lies.
targetTexts.6: A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
targetTexts.7: Stay away from a foolish man; you will gain no knowledge from his speech.
targetTexts.8: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools deceives them.
targetTexts.9: Fools mock the making of amends, but goodwill is found among the upright.
targetTexts.10: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares in its joy.
targetTexts.11: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
targetTexts.12: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
targetTexts.13: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in sorrow.
targetTexts.14: The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, but a good man is rewarded for his ways.
targetTexts.15: The simple man believes every word, but the prudent man watches his steps.
targetTexts.16: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
targetTexts.17: A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, and a devious man is hated.
targetTexts.18: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
targetTexts.19: The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
targetTexts.20: The poor man is hated even by his neighbor, but many are those who love the rich.
targetTexts.21: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who shows kindness to the poor.
targetTexts.22: Do not those who contrive evil go astray? But those who plan goodness find loving devotion and faithfulness.
targetTexts.23: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
targetTexts.24: The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the effort of fools is folly.
targetTexts.25: A truthful witness saves lives, but one who utters lies is deceitful.
targetTexts.26: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
targetTexts.27: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
targetTexts.28: A large population is a king’s splendor, but a lack of subjects is a prince’s ruin.
targetTexts.29: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man promotes folly.
targetTexts.30: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
targetTexts.31: Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
targetTexts.32: The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin, but the righteous man has a refuge even in death.
targetTexts.33: Wisdom rests in the heart of the discerning; even among fools she is known.
targetTexts.34: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
targetTexts.35: A king delights in a wise servant, but his anger falls on the shameful.
